principles: Templates provide discovery defaults and questions, not mandatory architectures.
Availability, RTO/RPO, compliance, budget and technical fit must be resolved before product selection.

templates.name: Generic IT infrastructure project
templates.description: General server/network/storage/UPS infrastructure when no narrower template applies.

required_fields.question: What applications/services will run on the infrastructure?
What is the user, concurrency or workload scale?
What availability, RTO and RPO are required?
What is the current data size and expected growth?
Is there a budget ceiling or target range?
Is domestic/Xinchuang compatibility mandatory?
What existing servers, storage, network, backup and licenses must be reused or integrated?

guardrails: Do not infer HCI, HA, dual-core switching or firewall requirements from the template.
Do not convert suggested assumptions into Mandatory requirements without project evidence.

templates.name: Small manufacturing SCADA / historian
templates.description: Small-to-medium factory centralized monitoring, historian, operator stations and OT integration.

required_fields.question: How many licensed SCADA I/O points are required?
How many points are actually historized?
What is the effective historian sample interval or change rate?
How long must historian data be retained?
How many operator/client stations and Web users are needed?
What downtime, RTO and RPO are acceptable?
Will SCADA issue remote start/stop, setpoints or other physical-control commands?
How many OT/IT ports, VLANs and cross-VLAN flows are expected?
What is the project budget ceiling or target range?
Is domestic/Xinchuang compatibility mandatory?

guardrails: PLC/equipment safety logic remains authoritative for physical control.
Historian sizing uses historized points and effective sample rate, not total licensed tags.
Do not default to HCI or redundant core switching.

templates.name: SMB ERP / database
templates.description: Small-to-medium enterprise ERP, database and application-server infrastructure.

required_fields.question: Which ERP/application and database engine/version will be used?
How many named users are expected?
How many concurrent users or transactions are expected at peak?
What is the current database size and annual growth?
What availability, RTO and RPO are required?
What backup retention and restore requirements apply?
What is the budget ceiling or target range?
Is domestic/Xinchuang compatibility mandatory?

guardrails: Verify ERP/database vendor support before choosing CPU architecture or OS.
Do not assume virtualization or HCI unless workload consolidation or availability justifies it.

templates.name: Small virtualization platform
templates.description: Consolidation of several business workloads onto a small virtualized cluster or host set.

required_fields.question: List workloads/VMs and their CPU, memory, storage and I/O demand.
What are aggregate peak CPU and memory requirements?
What failures must the platform tolerate and what are the RTO/RPO targets?
What capacity, IOPS, latency and growth requirements apply to shared/local storage?
What management, VM, storage and migration network bandwidth is required?
Is there a required/supported hypervisor or virtualization platform?
What is the budget ceiling or target range?

guardrails: Virtualization does not automatically imply HCI.
N+1/HA capacity must be calculated only when the availability target requires it.

templates.name: Small VDI / desktop cloud
templates.description: Small virtual-desktop deployment for office, design or controlled desktop workloads.

required_fields.question: How many total and concurrent virtual desktops are required?
What user profiles exist (office, CAD/BIM, developer, GPU-assisted)?
What CPU and memory envelope is required per profile?
Do any profiles require GPU/vGPU, and which applications must be certified?
What login/boot-storm and storage IOPS requirements apply?
What desktop/service availability, RTO and RPO are required?
What VDI, OS, GPU/vGPU and application licensing constraints apply?
What is the budget ceiling or target range?

guardrails: Do not size VDI from desktop count alone; profile mix and concurrency matter.
GPU/vGPU selection requires application and platform compatibility evidence.

templates.name: Edge computing node
templates.description: Industrial/branch edge compute where environment, remote operation and limited local footprint matter.

required_fields.question: What workloads/services must run locally at the edge?
What temperature, dust, humidity, vibration and installation constraints apply?
How long must the site operate during WAN/cloud loss?
What local availability, RTO and RPO are required?
What out-of-band and remote-management capabilities are required?
What power input, UPS/runtime and heat-dissipation limits apply?
What is the budget ceiling or target range?

guardrails: Environmental and remote-recovery requirements are Mandatory when the site cannot be serviced quickly.
Do not assume datacenter-grade environmental conditions.

templates.name: Backup / archive storage
templates.description: Backup repository, archive or secondary storage selection.

required_fields.question: How much source data is protected today?
What is the daily change rate?
What daily/weekly/monthly retention policy is required?
What backup and restore windows must be met?
What RPO/RTO applies to protected workloads?
Is immutability, air-gap or offline copy required?
Which backup software/protocols must the storage support?
What is the budget ceiling or target range?

guardrails: RAID is not an independent backup.
Capacity must include retention, change rate, compression/dedup assumptions and growth.
